phase: U12 A (STRAT, RE) - the windows that reload only from a file resume their session through it: their loader is named by _SESSION_FILE_LOADER, the session goes through a temporary file, and comes back unsaved.
note: _SESSION_FILE_LOADER is None for every other window (their own _apply_config is used, as before). The loader of STRAT and RE marks what it loaded as saved: the resumed session is marked unsaved again, so that the close still asks. Collect then apply gives back the same configuration in the eight windows (tested).
